text:
The median asking rent in Bocholt stands at 10.0 €/m², up 2.8 % year‑on‑year and 23.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. Asking rents are about 60 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.26 €/m², and a 60 m² unit costs roughly 600.0 €/month.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.5 % and an average of 30 days on market; only 20 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 12.3 %, while mortgage rates sit at 4.01 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.38 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.05 €/m² and 10.78 €/m², implying a 3.8 % increase.
